title: array[]::oidvector 本应报 'array is not a valid oidvector'；17.5 打印 40 个相邻堆字。ASan 静默——越界读留在 palloc 块内，错误答案是唯一证据
live_proof: CVE-2026-2003, fixed upstream in 3d160401b65e, which postdates the 17.5 pin. On the pin the cast is accepted where a correct build rejects it: the purecap run errors on 0 of the 2 statements upstream refuses
fidelity: real server, core. The out-of-bounds read stays inside the palloc block, so no sanitizer and no capability machine sees it; the accepted input is the evidence. On the host the same case printed about forty words of adjacent heap, and on the purecap arm the value came back empty -- the arms show different amounts of the same defect, which is recorded rather than averaged

spatial.precondition: PGSU_NESTED=none. needs the Capstone application VM: a case is SQL run against a real postgres process, not a freestanding domain. Every attempt needs a fresh copy of a cluster made by the 16-byte-MAXALIGN backend (app/build-native16-fixture.py); an ordinary 8-byte native cluster is not interchangeable. Set CAPSTONE_REV_NODES=262144: this workload exhausts the 65536 default and passes at 262144 with a high-water mark of 84193 nodes (capstone/ports/common/application/README.md lines 36-37; the measurement is nodes_high_water in ports/common/application/results/20260929-delegation.json). Scoring: node exhaustion is a resource limit, not a detection -- it surfaces as cause 30 (RISCV_EXCP_INSUF_RESOURCES = 0x1e, capstone-qemu/target/riscv/cpu_bits.h), so an oracle that counts faults will score it as a catch. Record causes by name: the emulator and the RTL number them differently (ports/nginx/e1-bundle/e1-bundle.py:151). Also: su can return 0 after a child SIGPROT, so exit status alone does not qualify a run; the adapter report has to agree.

cheribsd-revocation.oracle: completes; the differential fires -- upstream rejects 2 statements and 17.5 rejected 0, so an input a correct build refuses was accepted. Note the arms differ in how much they show: the host oracle printed about forty words of adjacent heap, here the value came back empty, so on this arm the accepted input is the whole of the evidence
